title: Minerals Support Project - Superior NF
agency: AGRICULTURE, DEPARTMENT OF > FOREST SERVICE > USDA-FS, CSA EAST 1
description:
NO OFFERS RECEIVED UNDER LANDS MANAGEMENT SUSTAINABILITY (LMIR) BPA SUITE SYNOPSIS NOTIFICATION. 

 This is a Synopsis in accordance with FAR 5.2 Synopsis of Proposed Contract Actions 

 This notice constitutes a Request for Quote (RFQ). Interested vendors are invited to submit quotations in accordance with the instructions and requirements outlined in this notice/attachments. 

 Solicitation Notice 12443927Q0015 

 Projected Closing Date: 07 Dec 2026, 1400 HRS EST 

 Procedure used to solicit and award contract: FAR Part 12 

 Projected Period of Performance: From contract award thru 30 Dec 2028. 

 Set-aside: TOTAL SMALL BUSINESS - Offerors must have an active entity registration in the System for Award Management in order to submit an offer. 

 PROJECT DESCRIPTION:  The Superior National Forest (SNF) needs technical assistance in the environmental review of forthcoming mineral projects including a potential hardrock, copper-nickel project mine plan. The purpose of this contract is to provide technical support in the evaluation of the Twin Metals Minnesota copper-nickel mine plan of operation (MPO) and related effects analysis required for environmental review and SNF decisions. all in accordance with the attached Statement of Work (SOW). 

 Address questions about this solicitation to amelia.davila-garcia@usda.gov. Telephonic and/or verbal questions will not be addressed. Questions submitted after 30 November 2026, 12 NOON EST may not be answered. 

 The Government is not liable for any vendor effort or cost incurred as a result of this notice, including but not limited to effort and costs associated with vendors’ preparation and submission of responses.
